name: BUNK'D: Learning the Ropes
description: Siblings Emma, Ravi, and Zuri Ross leave their extravagant New York City penthouse once again to return to Camp Kikiwaka, a rustic summer camp in Maine where their parents met as teenagers.

videos.title: Welcome to Camp Kikiwaka
videos.overview: In the premiere episode, the Ross kids arrive at camp. The camp's owner, Gladys, is even scarier than the legendary creature that's rumored to stalk the grounds. With the help of her sneaky niece Hazel, she's out to get the Ross kids because of her decades-old rivalry with their mom.

videos.title: Gone Girl
videos.overview: Ravi becomes suspicious when he overhears Xander’s plans for his first date with Emma. Meanwhile, Zuri and Jorge set up a secret business selling candy and video games to the campers.

videos.title: Camp Rules
videos.overview: Emma and Zuri won’t stop fighting, so Lou sends them out in a canoe in the middle of the lake to work out their differences.

videos.title: Smells Like Camp Spirit
videos.overview: Emma and Xander lose the camp spirit stick, which curses the campers with bad luck! Meanwhile, Jorge and Tiffany try to teach Ravi how to swim.

videos.title: The Ones That Got Away
videos.overview: Emma and Xander team up for a fishing competition. Meanwhile, Zuri and Tiffany devise a plan to steal fish from the mess hall to submit in the contest.

videos.title: Can You Hear Me Now?
videos.overview: Zuri secretly keeps her cell phone beyond the allotted time, which puts Emma in a tough spot. Meanwhile, Ravi and Tiffany are duped into making a cell phone tower that is hidden in the new camp totem pole.

videos.title: Friending with the Enemy
videos.overview: Emma convinces Lou that they should make an effort to become friends with Hazel. Meanwhile, a TV producer gets Ravi, Zuri and Tiffany to help him hunt the legendary Kikiwaka monster.

videos.title: Waka, Waka, Waka!
videos.overview: Ravi and Tiffany get video proof that the Kikiwaka exists. Meanwhile, Emma and Lou try to outsell Hazel at the Kikiwaka Day Festival.

videos.title: Secret Santa
videos.overview: Emma and Lou are determined to hold a holiday gift exchange, but when Ravi gives them advice, it doesn’t quite work out as planned. When Zuri, Xander, Jorge, and Tiffany run into a man they think is the real Santa, they need to work together to cheer him up and save Christmas.

videos.title: Counselors' Night Off
videos.overview: Emma sneaks out to the "Counselors' Night Out" party to eavesdrop on Xander, leaving Ravi in charge back at camp.

videos.title: There's No Place Like Camp
videos.overview: When Xander and Ravi realize that Jorge is homesick, they enlist the help of Emma, Zuri and Tiffany to cheer him up.

videos.title: Luke's Back
videos.overview: Luke reunites with his siblings to get some summer school help from Ravi. Meanwhile a turf war erupts between Camp Kikiwaka and the rival camp across the lake.

videos.title: No Escape
videos.overview: When Jorge and Zuri sneak out to buy something from the general store in town, Emma and Xander have to get them back before Gladys notices they’re all gone!

videos.title: Close Encounters of the Camp Kind
videos.overview: After the campers think they see a UFO land in Lake Kikiwaka, a new boy shows up and Jorge and Tiffany think he's an alien. Meanwhile, Emma and Ravi get evaluated by the camp counselors.

videos.title: Crafted and Shafted
videos.overview: During an overnight camping trip, the kids must use their survival skills after Emma and Xander get lost in a cave.

videos.title: Boo Boos and Birthdays
videos.overview: Emma and Zuri butt heads when trying to plan a surprise birthday party for Tiffany. Meanwhile, in order to get out of a volleyball tournament, Ravi and Jorge fake injuries.

videos.title: For Love and Money
videos.overview: Lou falls for a handsome young lumberjack, but Emma and Zuri are suspicious of him. Xander sets Ravi and Jorge on a treasure hunt.

videos.title: Love Is for the Birds
videos.overview: Emma and Jorge help Ravi when he starts dating a girl who is his polar opposite. Meanwhile, Zuri and Tiffany try to return an eagle egg to its nest.

videos.title: Bride and Doom
videos.overview: The campers learn about Olga, the daughter of the camp founder whose ghost supposedly haunts Kikiwaka. A camp wedding may be the only way to rid the camp of the ghost.

videos.title: Live from Camp Kikiwaka
videos.overview: When Gladys announces that Camp Kikiwaka may close, Emma, Xander and Lou host a live stream to try and save the camp.

videos.title: Xander Says Goodbye
videos.overview: Emma and Xander are forced to make some tough decisions when his dad wants him to leave camp for football training. Meanwhile, Emma, Ravi and Lou put him through some drills.

videos.title: Griff Is in the House!
videos.overview: The Ross kids leave their New York penthouse and return to Camp Kikiwaka for the summer where to their surprise, find an unexpected camp addition and the Woodchuck cabin’s new startling counselor.

videos.title: Dance in My Pants
videos.overview: Camp Kikiwaka hosts its annual dance which has Tiffany and Zuri hopeful that they’ll dance with a cute boy. Emma learns that Lou and Xander have a history.

videos.title: Zuri Has a Little Lamb
videos.overview: Lou assigns Zuri and Emma to barn duty. Meanwhile, the boys discover that Gladys has been hiding a secret in the woods.

videos.title: Weasel Out
videos.overview: To Zuri's dismay, Hazel makes her a CIT in the Weasel cabin. Jorge and Griff convince Ravi that the camp's horse has a hidden talent.

videos.title: Queen of Screams
videos.overview: Jorge enters a short story contest and wins a dinner with his favorite horror novelist, Stephanie Queen, and decides to bring along a few of his fellow campers for the thrilling experience. Meanwhile, Xander must act as referee between Emma and Ravi.

videos.title: Luke Out Below
videos.overview: Luke returns to camp and decides to take Griff and Zuri on an adventure to prove that he can be just as responsible as the other CITs.

videos.title: Camp Kiki-Slasher
videos.overview: Things get scary at Camp Kikiwaka when the campers start disappearing one by one. When they finally uncover the culprit with the axe to grind, he takes them on a thrill ride the campers will never forget!

videos.title: Treehouse of Terror
videos.overview: Zuri, Jorge and Tiffany enlist the support of an unexpected camper to help restore an abandoned tree house they found as their new hangout. Meanwhile, Emma and Lou, Ravi and Xander get competitive during a friendly game of billiards.

videos.title: Tidal Wave
videos.overview: Zuri helps Xander create a music video for his song "Tidal Wave" in the hopes of turning him into a social media star; meanwhile, Ravi and Lou join forces to try to do something nice for Griff.

videos.title: Fog'd In
videos.overview: A strange, toxic fog overtakes Camp Kikiwaka causing the campers to develop bizarrely altered personalities and it’s up to the camp counselors to save the day.

videos.title: How the Griff Stole Christmas
videos.overview: The campers participate in a gift-making activity for the upcoming holiday and Griff is not into it. Ravi and Lou try to create a special memory for Griff, while Santa asks Jorge to babysit for one of his reindeers.

videos.title: Food Fight
videos.overview: When Murphy challenges the kids to cook the camp dinner, Zuri orchestrates a heated competition between the counselors and the CITs.

videos.title: Mother May I?
videos.overview: Lou is in awe when her hero, the legendary Christina Ross, pays a visit to Camp Kikiwaka. The boys from Grizzly Cabin head out for an overnight camping trip.

videos.title: Mud Fight
videos.overview: After disobeying Ravi's wishes when on a hike, Zuri, Tiffany and Jorge get into a muddy situation. Meanwhile, Lou finds herself smitten and imagines what her life would be like in 1916 with her crush.

videos.title: Dog Days of Summer
videos.overview: When Lou decides to leave Camp Kikiwaka after she learns about the passing of her dog, the campers get together to help her realize how much she means to them.

videos.title: Bad Dog!
videos.overview: Emma, Tiffany and Zuri are not happy when Lou's new puppy, Chuck, wreaks havoc on the Woodchuck cabin. Meanwhile, Ravi encourages Jorge to do his best to set a camp record in order receive a plaque.

videos.title: Camp Stinky Waka
videos.overview: When Tiffany’s mother comes to visit, the Woodchucks try to help Tiffany pretend that Camp Kikiwaka is a camp for geniuses.

videos.title: Cabin vs. Cabin
videos.overview: The Woodchuck, Grizzly and Weasel cabins compete in Camp Kikiwaka's annual "Cabin of the Year” competition.

videos.title: Dreams Come True
videos.overview: As the end of camp nears, Griff gets some unexpected news that changes his life.

videos.title: We Didn't Start the Fire
videos.overview: To celebrate their last night at camp, the kids go on an overnight camping trip; Ravi and Emma take their final tests to become counselors.

videos.title: The Great Escape
videos.overview: Xander and Emma learn two of their campers have a crush on one another.

videos.title: We Can't Bear It!
videos.overview: Returning to camp, the campers find some changes around them.

videos.title: Let's Bounce!
videos.overview: After learning they are officially the new owners of Camp Kikiwaka, the Ross siblings have to decide which one of them will actually be in charge of the camp.

videos.title: Take the Cake
videos.overview: When Lou decides that the campers should practice public speaking, Matteo and Destiny help Finn overcome his fear.

videos.title: O Sister, Where Art Thou?
videos.overview: Ravi helps Matteo overcome his fears using hypnosis, but Matteo's newfound confidence could get him into trouble.

videos.title: Cav'd In
videos.overview: After Matteo and Finn express their frustration with Ravi's spying, Ravi decides to use a drone to spy on them instead.

videos.title: By All Memes
videos.overview: Emma decides to give everyone back their cell phones to foster camp unity and bring everyone closer together on her new Campstagram app.

videos.title: A Whole Lotta Lobsta
videos.overview: The Kikiwaka lobster festival is coming up and the Ross kids are determined to make it the best festival ever. Unfortunately, everything goes wrong and it ends up being a disaster!

videos.title: No Bones About It
videos.overview: Matteo and Finn come across a strange collection of bones and suspect the bones are from a new species. They set a trap for the creature and want credit for their new discovery.

videos.title: Finder's Keepers, Lou's a Weeper
videos.overview: Finn, Matteo, and Destiny fix up an old car as a present for Lou's 10-year anniversary at Camp Kikiwaka. Emma, Ravi, and Zuri decide to throw Lou a surprise party.

videos.title: Reversal of Fortune
videos.overview: The counselors clean out the storage room and find a fortuneteller machine that reveals something important will go missing and a sister will betray another sister.

videos.title: Game of Totems
videos.overview: Everyone prepares for the upcoming camp tournament, the Kikiwaka Cup; Zuri, captain of the campers team, is confident that her group will finally beat the counselors.

videos.title: Toilets and Tiaras
videos.overview: When Zuri decides to host a beauty pageant at Camp Kikiwaka, Destiny is very excited but Lou wants nothing to do with it.

videos.title: Bungle in the Jungle
videos.overview: Lou decides to go to college the following year, but her mother wants her to take over the family farm.

videos.title: Gruel and Unusual Punishment
videos.overview: The children explore the booths at Camp Kikiwaka's Olde Moose Rump Days; after finding an old wooden box from Zuri's booth, the kids suddenly find themselves in the 1600s wearing Colonial garb.

videos.title: It's a Blast!
videos.overview: The campers prepare to participate in a model rocket competition where they will face three rounds, including altitude, speed, and safety.

videos.title: Up, Up and Away
videos.overview: Because Emma, Zuri and Ravi have new jobs, their mother wants to sell the camp. Worried that Lou will be devastated when she finds out, the three tell it her on a balloon ride.

videos.title: Who da Boss? Lou da Boss!
videos.overview: It’s a new summer at Camp Kikiwaka as Lou takes over as camp director and welcomes new camper Gwen and camp counselors Noah and Ava.

videos.title: Kikiwaka's Got Talent
videos.overview: Finn and Matteo’s friendship is tested as they try to figure out an act for Camp Kikiwaka’s annual talent show. Meanwhile, Destiny tries to impress Noah with her pageant skills.

videos.title: Yes, Lies and Tower Escape
videos.overview: After Gwen accidentally breaks a window, she and Destiny get caught in a web of lies. Noah challenges Ava to be open to more things by saying “yes and …” to opportunities.

videos.title: An Udder Disaster
videos.overview: Finn offers to care for Lou’s beloved cow Bessie but must prove he can handle the responsibility. Meanwhile, Destiny and Gwen concoct a plan to patch things up between Ava and her mother, and Matteo helps Noah learn French for an audition.

videos.title: Hot Spring Friend Machine
videos.overview: Lou helps Gwen build her confidence when she learns that her parents plan to send her to school at the end of the summer. Ava discovers a hot spring at Camp Kikiwaka and enlists Noah to keep it a secret.

videos.title: Water Under the Dock
videos.overview: Destiny organizes a square dance to raise money to clean up Lake Kikiwaka and invites Noah’s arch-acting rival, Austin Justin. Meanwhile, Lou and Finn offer Matteo advice after learning he wants to ask Gwen to dance.

videos.title: In Your Wildest Screams
videos.overview: Gwen warns everyone that her dream effigy doll, Cuddles, can cause nightmares. The others laugh, but it doesn’t take long to realize Cuddles’ true power.

videos.title: Inn Trouble
videos.overview: Camp Kikiwaka gets a surprise visitor … Hazel! Hazel says she’s changed, so Lou agrees to let her hang out for a few days. The boys attempt to earn the camp’s highest honor.

videos.title: Lake Rancid
videos.overview: When a magazine contacts Destiny to do a story on her community service, Matteo, Gwen and Finn help her clean only one area of the shore, hiding the rest of the trash.

videos.title: Between a Raccoon and a Hard Place
videos.overview: Gwen befriends the Extreme Team, a group of campers known for its gutsy outdoor activities and accepts an invitation to hike to Dead Horse Drop.

videos.title: Mo-Squito Mo Problems
videos.overview: Mosquitoes are rampant, so Matteo looks to science to create a repellent. However, he ends up taking credit for something that Gwen invented.

videos.title: Sore Lou-ser
videos.overview: It’s time for the annual “Sportsmanship Games” against Kikiwaka’s rival, Camp Champion. Lou tries her best to “coach up” the campers knowing that Kikiwaka loses every year.

videos.title: Lone Wolf
videos.overview: Gwen is surprised when her older brother Jasper unexpectedly shows up to Camp Kikiwaka and encourages her to leave with him.

videos.title: Serfs Up-rising
videos.overview: It’s Renaissance week, so Lou assigns roles for each camper to play. Finn is declared the king and gets to run the camp for a week, but he ultimately makes the camp miserable.

videos.title: Summer Winter Wonderland
videos.overview: When the temperature drops, Lou deems it Christmas in July; Gwen reveals that she doesn't understand Christmas traditions, so Lou shows her what real Christmas spirit is all about.

videos.title: Cramped Champions
videos.overview: The pool at Camp Champion floods the grounds. Barb and her campers are left camp-less. Lou invites Barb and her kids to stay at Kikiwaka for a week, but immediately regrets it.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Stackers
videos.overview: When Lou discovers the diary of the camp founder, Jedediah Swearengen, she is shocked to learn that her hero was a traitor! It’s up to Destiny and Ava to snap Lou out of her funk.

videos.title: Whatever Floats Your Goat Boat
videos.overview: Lou discovers that Mayor Higgins, who is up for re-election, is actually a goat! Lou decides to run against him with a sloth named Mrs. Fuzzybelly.

videos.title: Snow Cups and Fisticuffs
videos.overview: To help the campers stay cool during a heat wave, Lou announces that she’s finally caved and bought a shaved ice machine for Camp Kikiwaka.

videos.title: The S'more, The S'merrier
videos.overview: With the end of summer on the horizon, Destiny reminds Finn and Matteo that they need to hang as much as possible with the time they have left.

videos.title: Lava at First Sight
videos.overview: When Ava’s brother Alex visits Camp Kikiwaka, Lou develops a crush on him!

videos.title: Town and Clown Relations
videos.overview: Lou puts on a fundraiser carnival at the camp to raise money for her first cause as Deputy Mayor.

videos.title: Whisper Toots
videos.overview: When Noah and Destiny notice Matteo sneaking off into the woods at night, they follow him and soon discover he is moonlighting at Miss Tilly's Inn.

videos.title: My Fairy Lady
videos.overview: Finn is not pleased when he finds out his mother's boyfriend, Dave, is coming to visit Camp Kikiwaka.

videos.title: Party Pooper
videos.overview: Lou is invited to a conference for camp directors, where she has been asked to give a speech; she allows Destiny to come with her, but soon regrets that decision.

videos.title: Squatters’ Fights
videos.overview: When Ava, Destiny and Gwen discover that the Grizzly cabin has a much larger bathroom than theirs, they hatch a diabolical plan to convince the boys to switch cabins.

videos.title: Three Stars and a Baby
videos.overview: When Lou asks the campers to fill out counselor evaluations, Ava fears Destiny and Gwen’s ratings and worries that her job may be in jeopardy.

videos.title: Manic Moose Day
videos.overview: When Lou’s travel-blogger friend, Sean, visits camp, Lou hopes it will help drive some business. But Lou quickly realizes it may be harder to impress her than expected.

videos.title: Breaking Barb
videos.overview: The Southern Northeast Conference of Camp Directors encourages Lou and Barb to participate in a camp director swap program.

videos.title: Raven About Bunk’d
videos.overview: Raven, Chelsea, Booker, Nia, Levi, and Tess set out on a long road trip to Maine's Camp Champion, but a GPS glitch sends them off course to Camp Kikiwaka, a place with an uncertain future even for those who can catch a glimpse of the future.

videos.title: Lou's Still the Boss, But Now There's a Ross
videos.overview: Camp director Lou, counselors Ava and Noah and campers Destiny, Matteo and Finn are delighted when Emma, fresh from her glamorous career as a fashion designer in Milan, pays a surprise visit to Camp Kikiwaka.

videos.title: Rise of the Machine
videos.overview: Noah and Ava face a new challenge when they take over the "PeeWeeWaka" day camp program for younger campers. Meanwhile, Destiny and Finn express very different styles when they co-host the camp radio news show.

videos.title: R.V. Having Fun Yet?
videos.overview: Much to Lou's surprise, Parker Preston arrives at Camp Kikiwaka to stake his claim to part ownership of the camp.

videos.title: Tentacle Difficulties
videos.overview: Ava volunteers Noah for a field trip to the Moose Rump Aquarium, but it turns out Noah's terrified of the ocean's creatures. Parker and Destiny debate the importance of a majestic tree.

videos.title: Luck of the Chuck
videos.overview: Ava and Noah work together to put on a puppet show for the PeeWeeWaka campers while Destiny helps Lou prepare for an important camp inspection.

videos.title: Look Who's Squawking
videos.overview: Ava insists that she wants to take on more responsibility this summer, so Lou assigns her the task of resurrecting the "Camper of the Week" program.

videos.title: Raucous Science
videos.overview: Lou signs up for a chemistry class to finish her college degree and is surprised to discover that Matteo is her professor. Meanwhile, Finn learns he has a new little sister on the way.

videos.title: Baton-man Begins
videos.overview: While visiting Finn in the hospital, Noah develops a crush on Destiny's new friend. Meanwhile, Ava attempts to interest Finn in reading.

videos.title: Everyone's Trap'd
videos.overview: With Lou stressed about camp duties, Parker completes Lou's assignment and drops it off at Matteo's classroom, but Lou does not want Matteo to think she cheated.

videos.title: Pop Pop Poppin' In
videos.overview: Hoping to be discovered, Noah enlists a reality TV crew. Lou’s overbearing grandfather pays a visit and criticizes her camp-running abilities.

videos.title: Roll Models
videos.overview: Ava and Destiny compete in an elaborate marble race. Lou, Matteo and Noah head off on a road trip where they encounter Noah’s NASA-bound older brother.

videos.title: Gi Whiz
videos.overview: Finn and Destiny look for a way to leave their mark on the camp. While meeting Matteo’s mother, Lou and Noah discover that he has a surprising skill.

videos.title: Dancin' Up a Storm
videos.overview: Lou drops in on her cousins at their family farm only to receive an icy reception to her surprise visit. Parker tries some creative methods to teach Finn how to dance.

videos.title: Out of the Doghouse
videos.overview: Destiny is excited for Ava to become an official Woodchuck. However, Lou tells Destiny that the initiation is canceled due to the noise complaints Junkyard Judy keeps filing against the camp.

videos.title: The Great Awkward Bake-Off
videos.overview: Lou sets up a cookie gram, where campers can send messages on cookies. Ava volunteers to run the project with Dante, and Destiny suspects it's because Ava has a crush on him.

videos.title: I Won't Let You Clown
videos.overview: Destiny re-discovers the clowning life when her friend Claire pays a visit; Lou enlists Parker and Noah to compete in a contest against Barb.

videos.title: Crushin' It
videos.overview: When Gwen returns for a surprise visit to camp, Noah and Destiny hatch a plan to create dangerous situations for Gwen to fix, hoping it will compel her to stay.

videos.title: Camp Creepy-Waka
videos.overview: When issues arise between her campers, Lou’s “Scary Story Night” helps them work through their differences.

videos.title: A Star is Torn
videos.overview: Lou’s favorite actress, Melody Chapman, comes to camp to shadow Lou as research for an acting role.

videos.title: Moose Queens and Possum Kings
videos.overview: When Destiny needs someone old enough to enter the Summer Moose Queen pageant, she enlists Parker and Ava for help.

videos.title: Frien'ds Forever
videos.overview: As another fun summer at Camp Kikiwaka comes to an end, the campers must confront change and fear of the unknown.

videos.title: Learning the Ropes
videos.overview: Lou and Parker must convince The Marshal to sell them the ranch. Noah and Destiny clash with new campers Bill, Jake, and Winnie.

videos.title: Never a Dull Moo-ment
videos.overview: Parker discovers something about the ranch's history. Destiny struggles with her first assignment as a counselor. Noah gets curious about what Bill does in his free time.

videos.title: Worst Aid
videos.overview: Winnie plans a risky stunt, to secretly audition for a reality stunt show, with Bill and Jake's help. Lou and Noah teach first aid to Destiny and Parker, but Destiny struggles under the pressure.

videos.title: Wrecks Mark Spot
videos.overview: Bill searches for treasure with Destiny's reluctant help, despite Lou's disapproval; Parker and Noah plan a dance performance but struggle to include Jake.

videos.title: Truth Sweat Free
videos.overview: Noah gets a mascot job downtown for The Marshal's unsavory new business. Parker asks Lou and Bill to teach him how to be a rancher. Destiny gets hooked on Jake's video games.

videos.title: Where the Buffalo Betties Roam
videos.overview: Lou, Bill and Destiny must get the jade compass back from a group of haughty socialites. Parker tries to improve the ranch with Winnie's help. Jake and Noah get a new roommate.

videos.title: A Recipe for Disaster
videos.overview: A child genius asks Parker and Bill to help her learn to have fun, while Destiny gets Winnie a drum set as an outlet for her energy. Lou and Jake set out to revitalize the food.

videos.title: Back in the Saddle
videos.overview: With Lou's help, Destiny competes in the Dusty Tush Rodeo Pageant. Parker, Winnie and Jake build a parade float, and Bill and Noah get an announcing job at the rodeo.

videos.title: Bunkhouse of Horror
videos.overview: A mysterious handyman tells the camp three spooky stories set on the ranch involving a cursed bracelet, a possessed scarecrow and a magic wishing well.

videos.title: Hauntin’ Around the Christmas Tree
videos.overview: Parker learns some important lessons about Christmas.

videos.title: Hope You Geyser Ready to Go!
videos.overview: Lou wants a group picture in front of an active geyser that only erupts every fifteen years, so Parker must get everyone up and ready so they can make it there in time.

videos.title: The Song Remains A Pain
videos.overview: Lou wins an award from a magazine, but Bill is suspicious of the reporter's motives. Parker and Jake prep Noah for a date. Destiny and Winnie try to write a song for their cabin.

videos.title: Art Imitates Life
videos.overview: Jake displays an unusual talent, which reveals secrets around the camp. Winnie is eager to ride a horse, and Bill tries to cover up a mistake.

videos.title: Wild West Side Story
videos.overview: A new dance camp has started nearby, which presents different challenges to Lou and Parker. Bill and Noah go fishing, and Winnie struggles with sleep deprivation.

videos.title: The Wrath of Con
videos.overview: A local convention featuring Noah's movie is disrupted by an unexpected star. Meanwhile, The Marshal's niece comes to camp, and Jake thinks he's discovered something in the lake.

videos.title: Finn It To Win It
videos.overview: Finn visits Kikiwaka Ranch on a mission, Bill’s new pet causes problems, and Winnie tries to fix a lock with disastrous results.

videos.title: Alpaca-lypse Now
videos.overview: Destiny, Bill and Parker must stall a livestock auction to retrieve a clue in the treasure hunt, Jake works on a gift for his moms, and Noah practices stunts.

videos.title: The Wicked Switch of the West
videos.overview: When Winnie becomes counselor for a day, Destiny decides to show her how her reckless behavior affects others. Meanwhile, Noah receives some bad news, and Lou plans a livestream.

videos.title: No Pain, No Grain
videos.overview: Winnie helps her brother Wayne propose to his boyfriend during their visit to the camp. Lou and Destiny teach Bill about self-care, and Parker finally gets his own place to stay.

videos.title: Shoe Drops and Chili Plops
videos.overview: Noah and Parker compete to win a pair of designer shoes. Bill enters a chili competition. Lou finds an old landline phone in the mess hall.

videos.title: Pickett Fencing
videos.overview: Bill’s twin sister Jill visits, ruining his hopes for a low-key birthday. Destiny and Jake suspect that Lou found the Lost Treasure of Dusty Tush. Noah teaches Winnie to fence.

videos.title: Model Citizen
videos.overview: Parker is nervous about his citizenship test. Destiny asks Jake to model her new clothing line. Noah takes Bill to the local ice cream shop, and Bill struggles to pick a flavor.

videos.title: Camp Fails and Beaver Tails
videos.overview: Unsupervised for the day, Winnie, Bill and Jake canoe to an island in the middle of Lake Tush. Parker wants to create a new camp activity. Lou helps Noah build a bookcase.

videos.title: Tap'd Out
videos.overview: Lou gets invited to join a Dusty Tush secret society; Jake is upset as he does not feel strong, so Noah and Bill make it seem like he's stronger; Winnie learns to dance.

videos.title: Badminton to the Bone
videos.overview: Destiny, Bill and Winnie get trapped in a bank vault while treasure hunting; Jake helps Lou and Parker find common ground; Noah finds out Megan has an ultra-competitive side.

videos.title: For Letter or Worse
videos.overview: Destiny plans the Tush Heritage Festival; Lou, Bill, and Jake resort to old school transportation methods to pick up BBQ; Parker tells Victoria how he feels.

videos.title: Butter You Doing Here?
videos.overview: Noah and Destiny must work with Ken, "The Perfect Counselor." Jake tells Winnie that she's one of his best friends. Bill enters a Future Ranchers of Dusty Tush competition.

videos.title: Writer's Locked
videos.overview: Lou invites her biggest fan, Oliver, to the camp to read her latest book. Noah gets invited to attend the premiere of his first movie. Parker asks Bill and Jake to watch his dog.

videos.title: Most Wanted
videos.overview: Winnie is accused of causing a stampede. Noah asks Parker and Megan to help him choose his next acting role. Bill gets "Most Changed" in his camp yearbook and spirals.

videos.title: Desperate Treasures
videos.overview: Desperate to save the ranch, Winnie, Bill, and Jake decide to finish the hunt for the Dusty Tush treasure. Meanwhile, Lou, Parker, and our counselors decide to hold a telethon.

videos.title: Cursed Day of Camp
videos.overview: Parker, Bill and Jake try to convince a reluctant Lou that the camp is cursed; Winnie and Destiny help a new camper fit in

videos.title: Workaversary Girl
videos.overview: Noah bonds with a new camper over their love for puppets; Lou enlists Winnie to help her pull a surprise together for Parker on their "Workaversary."

videos.title: Meat Cute
videos.overview: Destiny and Parker compete to open a restaurant on Main Street; Winnie enlists Noah to help her sleep without her baby blanket.

videos.title: An Arrow Victory
videos.overview: After a food critic arrives at Destiny's restaurant, things quickly go awry; Parker tricks Winnie into thinking she's good at archery to boost her self-esteem.

videos.title: Hot Couture
videos.overview: Winnie, Bill, Jake and Scout compete for A/C on the hottest day of the summer while Destiny and Noah compete to prove they are the best dressed counselor at camp.

videos.title: What About Barb?
videos.overview: Lou, Winnie and Jake team up to help Barb Barca.

videos.title: Wastin' Away Again in Barb-Aritaville
